language: "Panjabi"

direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Other"
poet: "Jaun"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false

1
Main Syed Zadi Haan Mera Naam No Chao.
Assi Ghairat-e-Nabi Haan Na Pathar Wasao.
Har Zulm Karo Logo Ayeh Zulm Na Karo.
Walaan Taun Phar Ke Asghar Da Sir Na Chao.

2
Main Sani-e-Zahra Haan Tatheer Di Waris.
Kujh Sharam Karo Logo Na Bazar Sajao.
Akhiyaan Choon Khon Roway Ghairat Da Shehanshah.
Aye Ne Batool Jaiyaan Na Chadraan Lao.

3
Zindan De Wich Mar Gayi Meri Bhain Sakina.
Qasim Ya Akbar Aa Ke Aidi Qabar Banao.
Haye Jaun Dukhi Zainab Dendi Si Aye Sada.
Sadi Be Ridai Te Aynj Na Jashan Manao.

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = 'src/data/lyrics/main-syed-zadi-haan-mera-naam-no-chao-lyrics-punjabi-2022-tajpoints-a254a51025060ba73dc3.md'
before = subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:'+p], text=True)
after = Path(p).read_text()
_, meta, body = after.split('---', 2)
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]

assert blocks(before.split('---', 2)[2]) == blocks(roman)
assert [b[0] for b in blocks(body)] == list('۱۲۳')

assert '\\u200c' not in body

item.text:
Reconstructed all 12 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved the original Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both editions have three matching four-verse stanzas.

Updated the titles and right-to-left Punjabi metadata, and removed the resolved `noUrdu` tag. I read “No Chao” in the title as `نوں چاؤ`.
